integrity: Finite numerical checks support the independent analytic proof; no external or independent audit has been performed. Source dates are evidence-backed, not inferred from revisions.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive c and exactly one permanently infected leaf on an otherwise homogeneous star. No distributional limit for the ordinary-leaf count, no unpinned metastable theorem. Historical priority remains provisional owing to incomplete access to Schwartz and Stone (2013).
title: Critical source-pinned SIS occupation on a star: an exponential crossover constant
